mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 61 degrees under clear skies by Badger Ridge Middle School. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will be 50 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released information regarding the proposed 2027 annual budget. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on November 4th to discuss several developments, including new residential plats and site plans for local businesses.

There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow and various trivia nights throughout the coming week, plus the Main Street Trick or Treat event on October 29th.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. The department is currently investigating the incident and confirms no students were harmed.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The Verona Culver's is currently open, though please note they close soon at 10 PM tonight.
